fix(session): hold the dispatch-pending lock across deleteFiles, gate claim writes on it too (P1, PR #509 tail #2)

session.Store.Delete (and Purge/PurgeTombstoned via deleteFiles)
cleared a session's mission sidecars and removed its roster under the
roster's own flock -- a lock no sidecar writer ever took. A resumed
session reusing the same session ID could write a fresh claim or
pending dispatch into the gap between the sidecar clear and the
roster's actual removal; once the roster is gone, List()/Purge() can
never find that session again, orphaning the fresh binding outside
purge discovery entirely.

deleteFiles now acquires mission.AcquireDispatchPendingLock once and
holds it across the whole clear-through-roster-removal span (not only
the dispatch-pending clear substep the previous commit added).
clearMissionSidecarsLocked documents that its caller must already hold
the lock and calls the raw ClearDispatchPending directly to avoid a
self-deadlock on re-acquisition. runMissionClaim now takes the same
lock before writing, closing the write-side half -- without it, only
dispatch writes (already locked) would have been excluded, not claim
writes.

Confirmed both halves red first: TestStore_Delete_HoldsDispatchPendingLockThroughRosterRemoval
against a simulated pre-fix deleteFiles (lock scoped to the clear
substep only) showed a sibling acquiring the lock before roster
removal; TestMissionClaim_WaitsForDispatchPendingLock against the
unlocked WriteActiveMission call showed the claim writing immediately
regardless of a held sibling lock.

make check green (race detector included); GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64
go build ./... exits 0.
EOF
)"
